title: LuLu: free Little Snitch alternative
caption:
Little Snitch charges $59 to show you which apps phone home. LuLu does it for free 🔥

✅ Alerts you when an app tries to connect, then you Block or Allow
✅ Every choice becomes a rule you can edit
✅ Block lists and a silent passive mode
✅ No subscription, no license key, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Heads up: on first launch macOS makes you approve LuLu's system extension and network filter by hand in System Settings, and it works best on a recent macOS

Comment "FIREWALL" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
